map.恒星视差距离计算器，输入周年视差角(角秒)按 d=1/p 求距离(秒差距)，用于: The stellar parallax distance calculator takes the annual parallax angle (arcseconds) and returns the distance in parsecs as d = 1/p, for ranging nearby stars.
map.周年视差 p（角秒）与距离（秒差距）互为倒数。: Annual parallax p (arcseconds) and distance (parsecs) are reciprocals of each other.
map.输入恒星周年视差角 p（角秒），按 d=1/p 求距离（秒差距）。: Enter a star's annual parallax angle p (arcseconds) and get the distance in parsecs as d = 1/p.
map.理解依巴谷、盖亚等卫星如何以视差法测量近距恒星距离。: Understand how Hipparcos, Gaia, and other satellites measure distances to nearby stars with the parallax method.
map.对比不同视差对应的距离尺度，认识视差法的量程上限。: Compare the distance scales for different parallaxes to see the range limit of the parallax method.

map.：d=1/p=1/0.1=10 pc，约 32.6 光年。若视差为 0.01″，: : d = 1/p = 1/0.1 = 10 pc, about 32.6 light years. With a parallax of 0.01″, d = 100 pc ≈ 326 light years. The smaller the parallax the farther the star, and the larger the measurement error.
map.地球绕日公转使近距恒星相对遥远背景在半年内呈现最大角位移的一半，这个角即为周年视: As the Earth orbits the Sun, a nearby star appears to shift against the distant background by half its maximum angular displacement over half a year; that angle is the annual parallax.
map.视差法能测多远？: How Far Can the Parallax Method Measure?
map.地面与早期卫星仅到数百 pc；盖亚卫星把精确视差推到数千 pc，更远则误差过大需: Ground and early satellite work reaches only a few hundred pc; Gaia pushed precise parallax out to several thousand pc, and beyond that the errors grow too large and other ranging methods are needed.
